description.en: Makes a match member invincible while transformed ("keshin"/avatar mode), or clears that invincibility. Accepts the same flexible 2-4 argument forms as CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN: a character ID string, or a team+player-number pair.
True to make the member invincible while transformed, false to stop forcing it.
Team ID (when called with 3-4 arguments) or a character ID string (when called with exactly 2 arguments).
Optional player number within the team; only used in the 3-4 argument forms.
Optional extra mode parameter; only used in the 4-argument form.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if fewer than 2 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Make a match member invincible while transformed for a scripted sequence
CMND_BTL_SET_KESHIN_INVINCIBLE(true, "para_cp0009");
